Valiant Capital Management LP Has Lowered Apple (Call) (AAPL) Stake; Tucows Has 1.71 Sentiment 
January 26, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade 
Valiant Capital Management Lp decreased Apple Inc (Call) (AAPL) stake by 15% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Valiant Capital Management Lp sold 600,000 shares as Apple Inc (Call) (AAPL)’s stock rose 12.78%. The Valiant Capital Management Lp holds 3.40 million shares with $524.01 million value, down from 4.00 million last quarter. Apple Inc (Call) now has $869.23B valuation. The stock decreased 0.14% or $0.24 during the last trading session, reaching $170.87. About 16.53M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since January 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Tucows Inc. provides network access, domain name registration, email, mobile telephony, and other Internet services in the United States, Canada, and Germany. The company has market cap of $578.68 million. It operates in two divisions, Network Access Services and Domain Services. It has a 42.08 P/E ratio. The Network Access Services segment offers mobile and fixed high-speed Internet access services under the Ting brand, and Internet hosting and network consulting services.
